Overview of NILMBENCH2026 Generalization Tasks
- T1 (Intra-Building): Trains and tests on disjoint time segments from the same home (e.g., train on 30 days from B1, test on 1 week from B1).
- T2 (Cross-Building): Trains and tests on different homes within the same dataset to evaluate performance on unseen residential buildings. For UK-DALE, models train on B1 and B2 , then test on B4 .
[ACM Digital Library]
- T3 (Cross-Dataset): Transfers models across entirely different datasets, countries, and voltage standards (e.g., training in the US and testing in the UK).


Evaluation Protocol
- Static Splits: Used instead of full rotation cross-validation due to disjoint temporal coverage and data sparsity across specific residences.
- Metrics: Evaluates regression accuracy (such as Mean Absolute Error - MAE) and event detection capabilities (F1 score), alongside operational costs like parameters, FLOPs, and runtime.
- Resources: You can explore the for reference implementations and experiment frameworks.
